title: Adding KPIs for V1 acceptance
description: From prd.md: add measurable KPIs for V1 acceptance (examples: LCP<=2.5s, CLS<0.1, accessibility pass rate checklist). Purpose: make success criteria testable and prevent scope creep.

title: Defining case study acceptance criteria
description: Require each case study to include: problem, approach, implementation details, validation steps, and a measurable outcome (before/after metrics where possible). Source: prd.md FR-03.

title: Documenting content authoring workflow
description: Create docs/CONTENT_WORKFLOW.md describing frontmatter schema, publish flow, and review checklist to ensure content extensibility without breaking templates. Source: prd.md FR-14.

title: Adding claim verification checklist
description: Add a verification checklist and source-audit step for the PRD requirement "free of fabricated professional claims"; specify required evidence fields and an approval step.

title: Specifying analytics measurement
description: Define analytics event names, provider (e.g., GA4), and a minimal event spec (page_view, contact_click, case_study_view) plus where to store the spec. Source: implementation-plan.md Production/Analytics.

title: Adding deployment and rollback strategy
description: Add a deployment checklist including health checks, canary rollout plan, rollback script and post-deploy validation steps to the Production epic or architecture docs.

title: Defining test coverage targets
description: Specify minimum test thresholds and types (unit, integration, e2e/smoke) and where results are recorded; include acceptance criteria referencing these targets.

title: Expanding accessibility checklist
description: List required WCAG 2.2 AA checkpoints for primary flows and describe concrete test steps (keyboard nav, focus states, contrast checks) to verify accessibility.

title: Adding frontmatter validation for MDX
description: Implement build-time frontmatter schema validation for MDX; supply sensible defaults when fields are missing and emit build warnings/errors as appropriate to prevent runtime failures.

title: Adding performance budgets
description: Add performance budgets (example: LCP<2.5s, FCP<1.0s, CLS<0.1) and a measurement plan; document where budgets are enforced and how to measure them.

title: Documenting privacy and data handling
description: Create a minimal privacy/data-handling section covering contact forms and analytics: consent requirements, data retention, and minimal vendor configuration.

title: Defining backend exception flow
description: Clarify "No unnecessary backend" by defining allowed backend use cases and an exception approval flow; add to architecture.md.

title: Handling absent/invalid MDX frontmatter
description: Add a code path: if frontmatter==null then supply defaults (e.g., title: "Untitled", slug: derive from filename) to avoid build-time errors. Source: implementation-plan.md MDX pipeline.

title: Bounding case-study content length
description: Render very long case-study content as collapsible sections and truncate previews with a "show more" to avoid layout overflow and poor usability.

title: Add image optimization fallbacks
description: Ensure image fallbacks: onImageError -> replace with placeholder; serve images with srcset and fallback sizes; handle CDN failures gracefully.

title: Add responsive container constraints
description: Set explicit min/max container widths using CSS clamp(), e.g., max-width: clamp(320px, 60ch, 1200px), to avoid extreme layouts on very wide or narrow viewports.

title: Honor prefers-reduced-motion
description: Respect @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) and disable nonessential animations to meet accessibility needs.

title: Add contact JS-disabled fallback
description: Provide a plain mailto: link fallback and a server-validated form action so contact remains available if JS is disabled or client-side handlers fail.
